questionSnapshot.question: In The Incredibles, what is the proper name of the island where Syndrome has his secret lair?

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged Syndrome’s Island as literally a true description. Final wording expressly asks the proper name, which Pixar labels Nomanisan. Omnidroid Base and Villain’s Cove are not that proper name.
